beats.headline: AAPL gains 3.2% following quarterly filings
beats.explanation: Apple shares rose 3.24% to $280.14 on 1.9 times normal volume following an 8-K filed April 30 and a 10-Q filed May 1. The advance outpaced peer MSFT (+1.63%) and diverged from NVDA (-0.56%), pointing to company-specific momentum.

beats.headline: AAPL drops 3.6% alongside sector peers
beats.explanation: No company-specific news accompanied this decline as Apple fell 3.65% to $290.55 on 1.7 times average volume. Peer MSFT also declined 2.02% and NVDA slid 0.22%, indicating the pullback was broadly sector-wide.

beats.headline: AAPL slides 6.1% in broad tech retreat
beats.explanation: Apple shares dropped 6.12% to $275.15 on 2.6 times typical volume with no company-specific filings or announcements. With peers MSFT down 3.46% and NVDA down 1.64%, the move tracked broader weakness across the peer group.

beats.headline: AAPL rebounds 3.1% on elevated volume
beats.explanation: Shares rose 3.14% to $283.78 on volume 6.3 times the 30-day average without any company-specific news. Peer MSFT rallied 5.71% the same day while NVDA fell 1.64%, indicating the bounce aligned with select large-cap peer strength.

beats.headline: AAPL gains 4.8% outperforming peers
beats.explanation: Apple climbed 4.84% to close at $308.63 on 1.8 times normal volume without company-specific catalysts. The move was largely idiosyncratic, as peer MSFT gained a smaller 1.62% and NVDA declined 1.39%.

beats.headline: AAPL advances 4.0% amid peer strength
beats.explanation: Apple increased 4.01% to $327.50 on 1.5 times typical volume in the absence of corporate news. The gain was supported by wider industry movement, with peer MSFT rising 2.78% and NVDA up 0.33%.

beats.headline: AAPL adds 3.5% while peers stay flat
beats.explanation: Shares gained 3.53% to $333.02 on near-normal volume of 1.1 times the 30-day average. With peer MSFT flat at +0.03% and NVDA dropping 0.92%, the move was company-specific despite no direct news evidence.

beats.headline: AAPL slides 7.4% after quarterly filings
beats.explanation: Apple dropped 7.35% to $308.91 on 3.2 times average volume following an 8-K filed July 30 and a 10-Q filed July 31. The selloff was company-specific, sharply decoupling from peers MSFT (+3.02%) and NVDA (+2.93%).

beats.headline: AAPL rises 3.6% diverging from peers
beats.explanation: Apple advanced 3.56% to close at $326.57 on 1.7 times normal volume without fresh company filings. The rally was distinct to Apple, as MSFT edged up just 0.16% and NVDA fell 2.37%.

arc: Between May and September 2026, Apple traded with significant volatility, marked by pronounced idiosyncratic reactions around its quarterly reporting dates alongside periodic sector-wide swings. A filing-driven bump in early May brought shares to $280.14 before a broad tech pullback dragged the stock down to $275.15 in late June. Apple rebounded sharply through July to peak at $333.02, but late-July filings triggered a severe single-day drop of 7.35% to $308.91, entirely diverging from positive peer momentum. The stock later resumed upward momentum to $326.57 in September, highlighting that while broad tech tides dictated mid-summer swings, company-specific filing dates created Apple's sharpest divergences from peers.
